items.source: Most framework-provided PropertySource implementations are enumerable; a counter-example would be JndiPropertySource where, due to the nature of JNDI it is not possible to determine all possible property names at any given time; rather it is only possible to try to access a property (via PropertySource.getProperty(String)) in order to evaluate whether it is present or not.
items.translation: 大多数框架提供的 `PropertySource` 实现是可枚举的；一个反例是 `JndiPropertySource`，由于 JNDI 的特性，无法在任何给定时间确定所有可能的属性名称；相反，只能通过尝试访问属性（通过 PropertySource.getProperty(String)）来评估其是否存在。

items.source: This implementation checks for the presence of the given name within the getPropertyNames() array.
items.translation: 此实现检查给定名称是否存在于 getPropertyNames() 数组中。

items.source: Create a new EnumerablePropertySource with the given name and with a new Object instance as the underlying source.
items.translation: 创建一个具有给定名称的新 `EnumerablePropertySource`，并以一个新的 `Object` 实例作为底层源。

items.source: Return the names of all properties contained by the source object (never null).
items.translation: 返回 `source` 对象中包含的所有属性名称（该对象永远不会为 `null`）。

items.source: Create a new EnumerablePropertySource with the given name and source object.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定名称和源对象的EnumerablePropertySource。

items.source: containsProperty in class PropertySource<T>
items.translation: `containsProperty` 在类 `PropertySource<T>` 中。

items.source: Return whether this PropertySource contains a property with the given name.
items.translation: 返回该PropertySource是否包含具有给定名称的属性。

items.source: name - the name of the property to find
